name: WA-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent seeking re-election in a deep-blue seat
Markets price a Democratic win near certain
model.rationale: The D+39 district, Jayapal's overwhelming financial advantage, and Polymarket pricing near 96% all point to a lopsided Democratic win; no evidence suggests a competitive race.
model.watch: Only a major scandal or unexpected incumbent withdrawal would put this seat in play.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Seattle-area WA-07 is one of the most Democratic-leaning House districts in the country, with a partisan lean of D+39. Incumbent Pramila Jayapal is running for re-election and has raised about $2.5 million, holding $1.8 million on hand, while Republican Nirav Sheth has raised roughly $12,000. No independent outside spending has materialized against her, and no expert raters list the race as competitive.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at about 96%, and there are no general-election polls suggesting anything other than a comfortable incumbent victory. The forecast expects Jayapal to win by a wide margin, with modest uncertainty reflecting the absence of polling.
